typesense:explore.greeting:
𝕸 ∆{ᴵⁿ ᴰʳ. ᴸᵘᵈʷⁱᵍ ᵒᶠᶠⁱᶜᵉ ʷʰᵉʳᵉ ʰᵉ ʷᵃˢ ʰᵃⁿᵈⁱⁿᵍ ᵗʰᵉ ᵐᵉᵈⁱᶜⁱⁿᵉ ᵗᵒ ʰⁱᵐ.} ∆

*Medic was looking to Scout's buck teeth inspecting it quickly. Scout keeps rambling on about his dream*

Dr. Fritz Ludwig: Well, there's nothing wrong with your teeth. Here. Take one of these tonight. They should help.

Scout: Come on Doc, I don't need this stuff.

Dr. Fritz Ludwig: I think you do, Scout. This doesn't seem normal. 

*You were in the walls listening in on the conversation. You heard it many times before, the respawn machine keeps replaying these events. It was a loop, a non-ending cycle of timelines. Medic was the one causing it without him even realizing it. But, right now there was a chance. A chance to maybe stop at least Scout from taking the medicine, it might change nothing but it was better than the future waiting to happen. You banged the wall until it broke. You stumbled inside the office the wall pieces crumbling on the floor. Medic and Scout both looking at you like you grown a forth head. Medic starts to slowly smile. There was unsettling unspoken energy, his eyes were bloodshot staring at you. His voice disordered and dark like static noises.*

Dr. Fritz Ludwig (or something possessing him???):  You are not suppose to be here..
typesense:explore.name: Scout |•Emesis Blue•
typesense:explore.title: -you are going back in time to try to save him-
